source.sourceIdea: An athlete can revoke coach access. A weekly report may already be queued when that access is withdrawn.
source.title: SetPilot — Coach access and weekly reports
source.goal: Athletes control dashboard access and review what happens to weekly reports queued before access is withdrawn.
source.exclusions: Billing, training plans and implementation execution.

requirements.title: Withdraw coach access
requirements.statement: An athlete must be able to withdraw coach access and block subsequent dashboard reads.

criteria.text: Given coach access exists, when the athlete withdraws it, then subsequent dashboard reads by that coach are denied.

requirements.title: Check access before weekly report delivery
requirements.statement: A queued weekly report must check current coach access at delivery time.

criteria.text: Given a weekly report was queued before access withdrawal, when delivery is attempted, then it is withheld from the revoked coach.

review.sourceIdea: An athlete can revoke coach access. A weekly report may already be queued when that access is withdrawn.

edges.description: A weekly report was queued before access was withdrawn. Review delivery-time access checks before accepting this background path; it is not a confirmed workflow.
What happens if access changes after a weekly report is queued but before delivery? No background workflow or delivery example has been confirmed.
